items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: I made a record with him and... Willie The Lion couldn't make it.

ctx.x: Do you think he was just too personal?
I don't remember what he died from. I made a record with him and... Willie The Lion couldn't make it. Who was the first Hammond organ player? What was his name? The White...
